instruction: Please change the text color to white. The black text is hard to read, I need it in white.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the user to change the text color to white instead of moving it. The evaluator checks if at least 80% of non-background pixels are white (RGB values > 200). Similar difficulty to original - both involve manipulating the text layer.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification is correct: instruction requires 'change text color to white', evaluator checks if text pixels are white (RGB > 200) via pixel analysis
Complete instruction coverage: single clear requirement (text color = white) is fully verified by the metric logic

Data flow logic is sound: postconfig exports GIMP image to PNG (Shift+Ctrl+E + filename 'white_text'), vm_file getter retrieves /home/user/Desktop/white_text.png from VM (file.py:74-143), metric opens and analyzes the exported PNG file (gimp.py:40)

Metric implementation is logically correct: (1) extracts file path from vm_file result dict (lines 26-32), (2) identifies non-background pixels by excluding orange background using RGB ranges (lines 62-64), (3) checks if non-background pixels are white with RGB > 200 threshold (lines 69-70), (4) calculates white pixel ratio and requires 80% threshold for pass (lines 78-83)

Edge case handling is comprehensive: FileNotFoundError (lines 87-89), empty non-background pixels to prevent division by zero (lines 73-75), general exceptions (lines 90-92), and None/missing file path (lines 34-36)
Postconfig workflow is appropriate: uses GIMP export keyboard shortcut (Shift+Ctrl+E), types filename, confirms with Enter, includes appropriate sleep intervals (0.5s, 2s, 5s) for UI responsiveness

Parameter handling follows framework conventions: metric uses standard 'result' and 'expected' parameters (line 10), expected.type='rule' with empty rules dict is appropriate for property-check metrics that don't need gold values

Static validator warnings are false positives: the warnings claim 'metric may not read vm_file result' but the metric DOES read the file via Image.open(file_path) at line 40 after extracting path from result dict
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Background color detection RGB ranges (lines 45-47) are hardcoded for orange background specifically - metric would need adjustment if background color changes, though this is acceptable since task setup uses orange_background.xcf file
No actual fix needed: The 80% threshold mentioned in previous review is already configurable via options.get('white_ratio_threshold', 0.8) at line 51, demonstrating good design
